info.text:
3 in 4 Americans live within 5 miles of a Dollar General. Here's why.
Fiscal 2025: $42.7 billion in sales, 82% of it consumables like food and paper goods.
Out of every $10 spent, about $3.07 is gross profit and about 52 cents is operating profit.
Sales grew from $27.8 billion (FY2019) to $42.7 billion (FY2025).
Sources: Dollar General FY2025 10-K and earnings release.
News and education, not financial advice.
